Madras High Court Halts MLA Poaching Case Probe

The Madras High Court has stayed the police investigation into the alleged bid to poach Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK) MLAs. The court also sought a response regarding a plea that requested the probe be transferred to the Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI). The stay on the investigation was issued by the court.
